Our Consolidated Financial Statements have been prepared on the basis that we will continue as a going concern for the next 12 months.

Based on our liquidity position and current forecast of operating results and cash flows, management has now concluded that substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern no longer exists, and that we have sufficient liquidity to meet our obligations as they become due within the next twelve months following the date of issuance of these Consolidated Financial Statements.
We aim to manage capital so that we can continue as a going concern while also maintaining optimal returns to stockholders, as well as other benefits for our stakeholders.
We also aim to maintain a capital structure that ensures the lowest cost of capital available to us.
